node.title: Re: Sorting array (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [negativ_m],

This is a frequently asked question, see for example the recent thread [id://1176809] for some solutions as well as links to other places like [id://68185] that give even more possible solutions. One possible module to help you is [mod://Sort::Key].

Update: I just realized your sorting rules appear to be unclear: text1g.txt comes after text2.txt but before text54f.txt?

Update 2: As [Eily] [id://1177226|noted], it does seem like you might want to filter the array instead of or in addition to sorting it. Please see [id://174051], at the very least you'd have to describe the algorithm for selection of the "latest version" as well as give enough test cases so we don't have to guess.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
